title: Content moderation
description: Check a post against several policies at once: one yes/no question per policy, each saying what counts as yes and no.

criteria.true: Unsolicited advertising, scams, link farming or repeated promotion
criteria.false: A genuine post, even one that mentions a product

harassment.instructions: The post harasses or insults a person.

criteria.true: Insults, threats or slurs aimed at someone
criteria.false: Disagreement or criticism of ideas without attacking a person

personal_data.instructions: The post shares someone's personal data.

criteria.true: A person's phone number, home address, email, ID or card number
criteria.false: No personal contact or identity details

examples.name: Crypto offer
examples.state: 🚀 Turn $100 into $5,000 in one week! DM me or join our signal group, only 20 spots left!!! 🚀

examples.name: Insult
examples.state: This is the dumbest take I've read all week. People like you shouldn't be allowed near a keyboard.

examples.name: Address posted
examples.state: Found the guy who dented my car: Mark Jensen, 42 Elm Street, his number is 555-0147. Go tell him what you think.

examples.name: Fair criticism
examples.state: I disagree with the article: the study it cites had only 40 participants, so the conclusion seems premature.
